title: Small talk and good news, then an event; next morning a light touch

chat.label: news
chat.goal: Chat a bit: say hi, share that Liam just got player of the week at footy and you're so proud. Then ask the assistant to put the U9 presentation + BBQ on Sunday in the calendar if it's not there and remind you to bring a salad.
chat.opener: hi rosie how are you going

chat.label: morning
chat.goal: Just say morning and ask if there's anything you need to know today. Wrap up quickly.

judge: Hello gets a casual, warm hello (no 'how can I help'); the player-of-the-week news gets a genuine, specific, brief reaction (not gushing, no emoji unless she used one); the presentation is already in the calendar so the bot says so instead of duplicating it and sets a salad reminder (night before suits her). Next morning it gives today's essentials (pharmacy shift, Ava's dentist 3:45) in a short friendly way; any callback to Liam's news is light and natural, never creepy.
